title: About A nocturnal portal cabinet for obsolete listening worlds: cassette hiss, painted thresholds, tiled cities, puppet folk horror, drone diagrams, and swamp radio all mounted as touchable apertures.
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 527 recent saved-signal files and 205 captured links, then narrowed the page to 6 source windows around @goo_vision: Portal and @muratcan: Gradient descent for SKILL.md files sounds interesting, maybe a bit complex but it's..., plus 4 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became A nocturnal portal cabinet for obsolete listening worlds: cassette hiss, painted thresholds, tiled cities, puppet folk horror, drone diagrams, and swamp radio all mounted as touchable apertures.: Full-bleed source-led plate for 2026-08-24. Use torn poster wall with torn wall; make Build one oversized cream industrial portal-machine silhouette against a saturated cobalt flat void, with the portal opening sitting high and slightly right of center. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 6 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against glowing blue aperture surface, white-flower vine crescent, and jagged torn blue wall edge.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
